text: They help me get through my day when I can't do it by myself as a grown adult, without feeling embarrassed or less. This app is the best thing that has ever happened to me in a very long time. It's the small steps that count! Thank you very much, All the way from the Canary Islands.
author: Isa brazzr
developer_reply: Thank you so much for sharing this. It really means the world to hear how dubbii is supporting you without judgement. You're absolutely right - it's all about the small steps. Sending lots of love to you in the Canary Islands. Team dubbii.

text: I think it would be great if the planner could be a total month, mostly because I want to try to repeat the routine, so if you could choose the same routine for all the week/month would be easier than choose each day of the week for brushing my teeth or breakfast. That would be very helpful.
author: Martina Anello
developer_reply: Hey! Thanks so much for the suggestion - it’s a great idea! Having the planner work for a whole week or month would make repeating routines much easier. If you can, please pop this into the Suggestion button in the app so the team can log it directly. We love ideas like this! Team dubbii.
